designs.name: Codex Workbench
designs.bestFor: Tablet power-editing and tuning loadouts without losing roster context.
designs.direction: Library → persistent roster tree, live detail pane and a validation rail; optional smart search overlays it.
designs.interaction: Select in the tree, edit on the right, watch legality update in the rail. Flip on smart search for type-to-add and AI suggestions.
designs.tradeoff: Shines on tablet; on phone it falls back to a more conventional drill-in.

groups.label: Product UI
groups.description: Portable product foundations and components intended for the React Native application.

reactNative.behavior: Expose semantic tokens rather than CSS variable names.
reactNative.accessibility: Every text/background pair must meet WCAG AA contrast.

reactNative.behavior: Map roles to platform fonts and scalable type sizes.
reactNative.accessibility: Support font scaling without truncating critical values.

reactNative.behavior: Use the native status bar and safe-area insets; do not recreate this preview.
reactNative.accessibility: Keep content outside unsafe display regions.

reactNative.behavior: Respect safe areas and keep roster progress visible while editing.
reactNative.accessibility: Expose titles, point totals, and progress as separate readable values.

reactNative.behavior: Present as a full screen or sheet based on navigation context.
reactNative.accessibility: Focus the heading first and provide a clear dismiss action.

reactNative.behavior: Adapt pane visibility to available width; preserve the selected unit.
reactNative.accessibility: Announce pane changes and preserve logical focus order.

reactNative.behavior: Progressively reveal game system, points, searchable faction and force pickers, then roster name.
reactNative.accessibility: Associate labels, hints, errors, and selected state with each control; trap focus in picker dialogs.

reactNative.behavior: Use virtualized rows for large rosters and preserve expansion state.
reactNative.accessibility: Expose hierarchy level, expanded state, and validation status.

reactNative.behavior: Use a bottom sheet on phone and anchored panel on tablet.
reactNative.accessibility: Trap focus in selectors and announce force creation results.

reactNative.behavior: Scroll detail content independently on tablet.
reactNative.accessibility: Use headings to separate configuration regions.

reactNative.behavior: Keep selection and point changes atomic.
reactNative.accessibility: Announce selection, disabled reason, and point impact.

reactNative.behavior: Present choices in a keyboard-safe bottom sheet on phone.
reactNative.accessibility: Announce group count, current choice, and price impact.

reactNative.behavior: Allow horizontal scrolling while retaining row identity.
reactNative.accessibility: Provide a linearized label for every stat value.

reactNative.behavior: Use a sheet stack with explicit back and close behavior.
reactNative.accessibility: Move focus to each opened reference and restore it on close.

reactNative.behavior: Pin above the safe area and retain the selected tab.
reactNative.accessibility: Expose tab role, selected state, and menu purpose.

reactNative.behavior: Use a native menu where available and a sheet fallback.
reactNative.accessibility: Return focus to the invoking row when dismissed.

reactNative.behavior: Allow one open row at a time and provide non-gesture alternatives.
reactNative.accessibility: All actions must be available without swiping.

reactNative.behavior: Avoid the keyboard and preserve the draft on transient errors.
reactNative.accessibility: Focus the text input and announce validation errors.

reactNative.behavior: List compatible destinations and confirm the completed move.
reactNative.accessibility: Explain why unavailable destinations are disabled.

reactNative.behavior: Navigate each issue to its affected entry.
reactNative.accessibility: Do not rely on color alone; announce severity and count.

reactNative.behavior: Virtualize results and keep filters visible.
reactNative.accessibility: Include availability and point cost in each row label.

reactNative.behavior: Optimistically add reusable configurations.
reactNative.accessibility: Differentiate favorite name from base unit name.

reactNative.behavior: Persist preference and expose entitlement state.
reactNative.accessibility: Describe the effect of enabling assistance.

reactNative.behavior: Persist language, dark-mode, and color-scheme preferences; allow language packs and color schemes to be imported from files.
reactNative.accessibility: Expose the current value, expanded state, selected option, and a named upload action.

reactNative.behavior: One row per installed source (version, upstream date, size) with one status chip by priority: Unreadable, Updating n%, Update available, Needs review, Ready. An updates notice offers Update all; Select enters a selection mode (update-available rows selectable, a bottom bar with Update n and Select all updates). Failed or interrupted installs keep a row with Try again / Dismiss. Checks on open (hourly) and pull to refresh; the footer says when it last checked.
reactNative.accessibility: Status chips carry icon and word; selection rows are checkboxes; the selection count is announced.

reactNative.behavior: Add game data is the hub: the default collection (first sources with Install, Show all), user collections and libraries, Add a collection or library, the repository link field (DS-2), and Search GitHub (the built Browse list on its own screen). Install starts the background install job at once (DEC-022/023).
reactNative.accessibility: Section headings; each Install button names its source; link errors are tied to the field.

reactNative.behavior: Native form sheet opened when an install or update starts: overall progress, steps (download, read, choose factions, import per faction, write, move rosters) with per-step progress, an Up next queue, Cancel (confirmed) and Hide. Hide, swipe down and Android back keep the job running in the worker (DEC-018, DEC-023).
reactNative.accessibility: Never show step state by colour alone (icon per state); announce step changes and the outcome, not every percent; Hide is labelled as continuing the work.

reactNative.behavior: Floating pill on every screen while a job runs: 12 pt above the tab bar, or above the bottom safe area on pushed screens and the roster workbench; screens add a bottom inset. Shows a progress ring, the job and its percent, '2 jobs' with a queue, and an accent 'needs you' state. Tap reopens the job sheet. Hidden while a sheet or the keyboard is open.
reactNative.accessibility: One button: job, percent, and 'Opens the progress'; announce only step changes and the end.

reactNative.behavior: End of a hidden job: success with View (or Report after an update that changed rosters), failure with Details (reopens the sheet in its failed state). Uses the built toast with an action (6 s); stacks above the job pill.
reactNative.accessibility: Announced without taking focus; the action is a named button.

reactNative.behavior: Top of the source detail: the new version and date, what changed (changed / new / removed factions, game system file) from a tree diff (nothing downloaded), a warning when rosters use a removed faction, Update and View on GitHub. Turns into a progress row while updating, a Last update card (View report) after, or a failure notice with Try again.
reactNative.accessibility: Heading for the card; the changes are a list; the progress row is one button that opens the job sheet.

reactNative.behavior: After an update (DS-5): summary chips, changed rosters with their changes (removed entries, cost changes, renames, new errors) and Open roster, unchanged rosters, and the data changes by revision. Kept until the next update of the source.
reactNative.accessibility: Each roster card has a heading; changes are not colour-coded only (a label per line).

reactNative.behavior: One collection (a JSON list of repositories) or library (a GitHub organisation): description, search above eight entries, rows with Supported / Installed / Update available / Archived chips and a trailing Install, Installed, Update, Queued or percent action. A cached copy shows offline. The menu offers Refresh, Copy link, and Remove (not for the default collection).
reactNative.accessibility: Row actions name the source; chips carry words; the offline notice is announced.

reactNative.behavior: Native form sheet: a link to a collection file or a GitHub organisation or user, Find, a preview of what was found, Add collection. A repository link offers Install it instead. Notes that collections only list repositories.
reactNative.accessibility: Label and helper tied to the field; errors announced; the preview card has a heading.

reactNative.behavior: Settings → Game data. A user preference, off by default (DEC-022: install everything). On, installs stop at Choose factions in the job sheet. Applies to the next install.
reactNative.accessibility: A switch with its label and the explanation as the hint.

reactNative.behavior: Inside the job sheet at Choose factions (Advanced installation on): Select all with a tri-state checkbox and a selected count (Deselect all when all are selected; with a search it selects the matches), search above eight factions, the built faction rows (installed ones marked and disabled), Install n factions and Cancel install. Nothing preselected. While hidden, the pill shows 'Choose factions for {name}'.
reactNative.accessibility: Select all is a checkbox with a mixed state; rows are checkboxes with documents and size in the label.

reactNative.behavior: Debounce queries, cancel stale requests, and preserve scope filters.
reactNative.accessibility: Announce result counts and async failures without stealing focus.

reactNative.behavior: Support local results while offline and report import progress.
reactNative.accessibility: Group results by type and announce import status.

reactNative.behavior: Use nested navigation with restorable tool state.
reactNative.accessibility: Provide text alternatives for charts and dice results.

reactNative.behavior: Lists header action: pick a New Recruit JSON file, import it in the engine worker, then open the roster; report unmatched parts without blocking, and send missing data to Sources. .ros/.rosz import comes later.
reactNative.accessibility: Name the action, mark it busy while importing, and announce the result notice.

reactNative.behavior: Sheet from the roster header: pick New Recruit JSON or text, preview the export (truncated for long texts), then Share (JSON as a file) or Copy. A roster with errors can still be exported; a banner says so. .ros/.rosz and more layouts come later.
reactNative.accessibility: Label the format control, keep the preview selectable, and announce the copied toast.

reactNative.behavior: Confirm destructive removal and retain list position.
reactNative.accessibility: Give add and remove actions distinct labels.

reactNative.behavior: Handle cached account data and sign-in transitions.
reactNative.accessibility: Do not expose email as the sole account identifier.

reactNative.behavior: Use the native navigation library and safe-area insets.
reactNative.accessibility: Expose tab role, selected state, and badge value.

reactNative.behavior: Keep the roster list available when organization controls are dismissed; adapt the organizer between an inline panel and a sheet.
reactNative.accessibility: Name search, folder, game-system, and tag controls and preserve the active filter when the panel closes.

reactNative.behavior: Allow the introductory prompt to be dismissed without hiding the empty roster state or creation action.
reactNative.accessibility: Give the close button a descriptive label and retain logical focus after dismissal.

reactNative.behavior: Use consistent recovery actions and preserve content during refresh.
reactNative.accessibility: Announce state transitions and make recovery actions reachable.
